_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Safety Studies Plan
summary: Describes how the contractor will conduct safety studies to achieve the safety requirements in the specifications, serving as the basis for the contractor's entire safety effort to identify and eliminate or control hazards through engineering design.
description_purpose:
3.1 This plan describes how the contractor will conduct safety studies to achieve the safety requirements set forth in the specifications.

3.2 This plan is the basis for the contractor's entire safety effort and provides assurance to the procuring activity that all hazards associated with the equipment are identified and eliminated or controlled by engineering design.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This Data Item Description contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

7.2 This DID supersedes UDI-H-23386.

7.3 This DID is to be used in conjunction with DI-SAFT-81065.

7.4 NAVSEAINSTR 8020.6 may be obtained from Commander, Naval Sea Systems Command, Attn: Code 09P21, Washington, DC 20362.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Safety Studies Plan shall be typed in the contractor's format on 8 1/2" by 11" sheets.

preparation_instructions.title: Contents
preparation_instructions.content: The Safety Study Plan shall contain a complete description of the effort planned to identify hazards associated with the subsystems and components in accordance with the latest version of NAVSEAINST 8020.6; Navy Weapon System Safety Program. Specifically, the plan shall contain:

children.title: Description of how following tasks will be accomplished
Review of Navy Systems Design requirements
Review of the effects of the system on Naval Facilities
Documentation of explosive ordnance disposal procedures and validation plan
